import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	in := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)
	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	defer out.Flush()

	var n, target int64
	fmt.Fscan(in, &n, &target)

	const mod int64 = 1_000_000_007

	firstCount := target / 2
	if firstCount > n {
		firstCount = n
	}

	sum := firstCount * (firstCount + 1) / 2

	remaining := n - firstCount
	sum += remaining * (2*target + remaining - 1) / 2

	fmt.Fprintln(out, sum%mod)
}

import (

	"os"
)

func main() {
	in := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)

	var red, blue int
	fmt.Fscan(in, &red, &blue)

	maxHeight := 0

	for height := 1; ; height++ {
		oddRows := (height + 1) / 2
		evenRows := height / 2

		oddBalls := oddRows * oddRows
		evenBalls := evenRows * (evenRows + 1)

		possible := (red >= oddBalls && blue >= evenBalls) ||
			(blue >= oddBalls && red >= evenBalls)

		if !possible {
			break
		}
		maxHeight = height
	}

	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	defer out.Flush()
	fmt.Fprintln(out, maxHeight)
}

	"os"
)

func main() {
	in := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)
	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	defer out.Flush()

	var num1, num2, num3 int
	fmt.Fscan(in, &num1, &num2, &num3)

	key := 0
	place := 1

	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		d1 := num1 % 10
		d2 := num2 % 10
		d3 := num3 % 10

		minDigit := d1
		if d2 < minDigit {
			minDigit = d2
		}
		if d3 < minDigit {
			minDigit = d3
		}

		key += minDigit * place
		place *= 10
		num1 /= 10
		num2 /= 10
		num3 /= 10
	}

	fmt.Fprintln(out, key)
}

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	in := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)

	binaries := make([]string, 3)
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		var n int
		fmt.Fscan(in, &n)
		binaries[i] = strconv.FormatInt(int64(n), 2)
	}

	sort.Slice(binaries, func(i, j int) bool {
		return binaries[i]+binaries[j] > binaries[j]+binaries[i]
	})

	result, _ := strconv.ParseInt(strings.Join(binaries, ""), 2, 64)

	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	defer out.Flush()
	fmt.Fprintln(out, result)
}

package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

const mod int64 = 1_000_000_007

func main() {
	in := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)

	var nums []int
	for {
		var x int
		if _, err := fmt.Fscan(in, &x); err != nil {
			break
		}
		nums = append(nums, x)
	}

	count := make([]int64, 100002)
	sum := make([]int64, 100002)
	var answer int64

	for _, x := range nums {
		idx := x + 1

		neighborCount := (count[idx-1] + count[idx+1]) % mod
		newCount := (1 + neighborCount) % mod

		newSum := (int64(x) +
			sum[idx-1] +
			sum[idx+1] +
			int64(x)*neighborCount) % mod

		count[idx] = (count[idx] + newCount) % mod
		sum[idx] = (sum[idx] + newSum) % mod
		answer = (answer + newSum) % mod
	}

	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	defer out.Flush()
	fmt.Fprintln(out, answer)
}

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	in := bufio.NewReaderSize(os.Stdin, 1<<20)

	var n int
	fmt.Fscan(in, &n)

	count := make([]int64, n+1)
	indexSum := make([]int64, n+1)

	var answer int64
	for k := 1; k <= n; k++ {
		var x int
		fmt.Fscan(in, &x)

		c := count[x]
		pos := int64(k)

		answer += c*(pos-1) - indexSum[x] - c*(c-1)/2

		count[x]++
		indexSum[x] += pos
	}

	out := bufio.NewWriterSize(os.Stdout, 1<<20)
	defer out.Flush()
	fmt.Fprintln(out, answer)
}

		fmt.Fprintln(out, 0)
	case prefix:

		fmt.Fscan(in, &s, &c)

		powerOfTwo := s & -s
		oddPart := s / powerOfTwo
		total[oddPart] += uint64(c) * uint64(powerOfTwo)
	}

	var answer int64
	for _, count := range total {
		answer += int64(bits.OnesCount64(count))
	}

	fmt.Fprintln(out, answer)
}

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	in := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)

	var n, a int64
	var x, y float64
	fmt.Fscan(in, &n, &a, &x, &y)

	memo := make(map[int64]float64)
	memo[0] = 0

	var solve func(int64) float64
	solve = func(v int64) float64 {
		if result, ok := memo[v]; ok {
			return result
		}

		fixedCost := x + solve(v/a)

		diceCost := 6 * y
		for b := int64(2); b <= 6; b++ {
			diceCost += solve(v / b)
		}
		diceCost /= 5

		result := math.Min(fixedCost, diceCost)
		memo[v] = result
		return result
	}

	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	defer out.Flush()
	fmt.Fprintf(out, "%.15f\n", solve(n))
}

	}

	for i := 0; i < len(moves); i++ {

		nextRow := row + d[0]
		nextCol := col + d[1]

		if nextRow >= 0 && nextRow < h &&
			nextCol >= 0 && nextCol < w &&
			grid[nextRow][nextCol] == '.' {
			row = nextRow
			col = nextCol
		}
	}

	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	defer out.Flush()
	fmt.Fprintln(out, row+1, col+1)

const mod int64 = 998244353

func main() {
	in := bufio.NewReaderSize(os.Stdin, 1<<20)
	out := bufio.NewWriterSize(os.Stdout, 1<<20)
	defer out.Flush()

	var n int
	var k int64
	fmt.Fscan(in, &n, &k)

	// dp[i] is the number of valid divisions of A[1..i].
	// grouped[s] stores the sum of dp[j] over prefix sums S[j] = s.
	grouped := make(map[int64]int64, n+1)
	grouped[0] = 1

	var prefix int64
	var total int64 = 1
	var dp int64

	for i := 1; i <= n; i++ {
		var a int64
		fmt.Fscan(in, &a)
		prefix += a

		dp = (total - grouped[prefix-k] + mod) % mod
		grouped[prefix] = (grouped[prefix] + dp) % mod
		total = (total + dp) % mod
	}

	fmt.Fprintln(out, dp)
}

	var elapsed int64

		switch queryType {
		case 1:
			birthTimes = append(birthTimes, elapsed)

		case 2:
			var t int64
			fmt.Fscan(in, &t)
			elapsed += t

		case 3:
			var h int64
			fmt.Fscan(in, &h)

			threshold := elapsed - h
			count := sort.Search(len(birthTimes)-head, func(i int) bool {
				return birthTimes[head+i] > threshold
			})

			fmt.Fprintln(out, count)
			head += count
		}
	}
}

import (

const mod int64 = 998244353

func main() {
	in := bufio.NewReaderSize(os.Stdin, 1<<20)
	out := bufio.NewWriterSize(os.Stdout, 1<<20)
	defer out.Flush()

	var n, m int
	fmt.Fscan(in, &n, &m)

	inv := make([]int64, n+1)
	inv[1] = 1

	var harmonic int64 = 1
	for i := 2; i <= n; i++ {
		x := int64(i)
		inv[i] = (mod - (mod/x)*inv[mod%x]%mod) % mod
		harmonic += inv[i]
		if harmonic >= mod {
			harmonic -= mod
		}
	}

	nMod := int64(n) % mod
	mMod := int64(m) % mod

	factor := (2*nMod%mod*harmonic%mod - 1 + mod) % mod
	answer := mMod * mMod % mod * factor % mod

	fmt.Fprintln(out, answer)
}
